description: PreCompact hard-stops manual and automatic compaction so PM state can be handed off first.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"auto compaction blocked; run /pm-handoff","systemMessage":"[ctx-tripwire] Auto compaction was blocked. Run /pm-handoff now, then continue in a fresh PM session.","suppressOutput":false}'
hooks.commandWindows: Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"auto compaction blocked; run /pm-handoff","systemMessage":"[ctx-tripwire] Auto compaction was blocked. Run /pm-handoff now, then continue in a fresh PM session.","suppressOutput":false}'

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"manual compaction blocked; run /pm-handoff","systemMessage":"[ctx-tripwire] Manual compaction was blocked. Run /pm-handoff now, then continue in a fresh PM session.","suppressOutput":false}'
hooks.commandWindows: Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"manual compaction blocked; run /pm-handoff","systemMessage":"[ctx-tripwire] Manual compaction was blocked. Run /pm-handoff now, then continue in a fresh PM session.","suppressOutput":false}'
